title: Leaked docs: right-wing X aggregator Visegrad24 used anti-migrant, pro-Israel content to become one of Elon Musk's top X news sources and raise tech funding (James Jackson/Wired)
summary: James Jackson / Wired: Leaked docs: right-wing X aggregator Visegrad24 used anti-migrant, pro-Israel content to become one of Elon Musk's top X news sources and raise tech funding — Documents reveal the sordid inner workings of Visegrad24, an obscure Polish influence operation that became one of Elon Musk's favorite sources of fake news.
